shots.name: launched-on-panda
shots.steps: for (let y = 0; y < 2400; y += 600) { scrollTo(0, y); await sleep(500); } const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('main section section')].find((x) => /Launched on PANDA|Lanzad[oa]s en PANDA/i.test(x.querySelector('h2,h3')?.textContent || '')); s.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await sleep(900); const r = s.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__clip = { x: 0, y: r.top + scrollY - 14, w: 900, h: Math.min(r.height + 20, 480) };

shots.name: search
shots.steps: const i = document.querySelector('header input, nav input'); i.focus(); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(i, 'bonk'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(4500); const box = i.closest('.relative'); const d = box.querySelector('.absolute'); const a = i.getBoundingClientRect(); const b = (d || i).getBoundingClientRect(); const left = Math.min(a.left, b.left) - 16; window.__clip = { x: left, y: 0, w: Math.min(1280 - left, Math.max(a.right, b.right) - left + 16), h: Math.min(b.bottom + 16, 520) };

shots.name: chart
shots.steps: const c = document.querySelector('[data-tutorial=chart]'); let card = c.parentElement; while (card.parentElement && card.getBoundingClientRect().height < c.getBoundingClientRect().height + 150) card = card.parentElement; const top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY; const bottom = c.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + scrollY; window.__clip = { x: 8, y: top - 6, w: 884, h: bottom - top + 44 };

shots.name: chart-market-cap
shots.steps: const press = (re) => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => re.test(b.textContent.trim()))?.click(); press(/^(Market cap|Cap\. de mercado)$/); await sleep(400); press(/^1h$/); await sleep(5000); const c = document.querySelector('[data-tutorial=chart]'); let card = c.parentElement; while (card.parentElement && card.getBoundingClientRect().height < c.getBoundingClientRect().height + 150) card = card.parentElement; const top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY; const bottom = c.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + scrollY; window.__clip = { x: 8, y: top - 6, w: 884, h: bottom - top + 44 };

shots.name: chart-zoom
shots.steps: { const c0 = document.querySelector('[data-tutorial=chart]'); const svg = c0.querySelector('svg'); svg.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await sleep(600); const r = svg.getBoundingClientRect(); for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) svg.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: 120, clientX: r.left + r.width / 2, clientY: r.bottom - 8, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); await sleep(700); } const c = document.querySelector('[data-tutorial=chart]'); let card = c.parentElement; while (card.parentElement && card.getBoundingClientRect().height < c.getBoundingClientRect().height + 150) card = card.parentElement; const top = card.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY; const bottom = c.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + scrollY; window.__clip = { x: 8, y: top - 6, w: 884, h: bottom - top + 44 };

shots.name: draw
shots.steps: const c = document.querySelector('[data-tutorial=chart]'); const d = document.querySelector('section[aria-labelledby=draw-title]'); const top = c.getBoundingClientRect().top + scrollY; const bottom = d.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + scrollY; window.__clip = { x: 8, y: top - 16, w: 884, h: bottom - top + 40 };

shots.name: draw-guide
shots.steps: const press = (re) => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => re.test(b.textContent.trim()))?.click(); const c = document.querySelector('[data-tutorial=chart]'); c.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); scrollBy(0, -90); await sleep(600); press(/How it works|Cómo funciona/); await sleep(1500); press(/^(Next|Siguiente)$/); await sleep(1200); press(/^(Next|Siguiente)$/); await sleep(2200); window.__clip = { x: 70, y: scrollY + 170, w: 680, h: 720 };

shots.name: trade-panel
shots.steps: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((x) => /Connect wallet to trade|Conecta tu wallet para operar/.test(x.textContent)); let el = b; while (el && el.getBoundingClientRect().height < 250) el = el.parentElement; el.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await sleep(700); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); window.__clip = { x: Math.max(0, r.left - 10), y: r.top + scrollY - 10, w: r.width + 20, h: r.height + 20 };

shots.name: draw-guide-phone
shots.steps: const press = (re) => [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => re.test(b.textContent.trim()))?.click(); const c = document.querySelector('[data-tutorial=chart]'); c.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); await sleep(600); press(/How it works|Cómo funciona/); await sleep(3200); window.__clip = { x: 0, y: scrollY, w: 390, h: 844 };
